result.topic_en: The page sets up the reversion of power series by expanding Ω = −log(1 − xz/y) in two ways, using coefficients (m,k) of the expansion of y^{-m} in powers of x, and derives a system of coefficient identities I, II, III, IV relating these expansions.
result.transcription:
Math 22 \quad (18) \quad [-46/18-]
Die Umkehrung der Reihen.
Es sei $x + axx + bx^3 + cx^4 + \text{etc.} = y$
$u + axuu + bxxu^3 + cx^3u^4 + \text{etc.} = z$
$-\log\left(1 - \frac{xz}{y}\right) = \Omega$
$\frac{1}{y} = \frac{1}{x}\left(1 + (1,1)x + (1,2)xx + (1,3)x^3 + \text{etc.}\right)$
$\frac{1}{yy} = \frac{1}{xx}\left(1 + (2,1)x + (2,2)xx + (2,3)x^3 + \text{etc.}\right)$
$\frac{1}{y^3} = \frac{1}{x^3}\left(1 + (3,1)x + (3,2)xx + (3,3)x^3 + \text{etc.}\right)$
u. s. w. oder allgemein
$y^{-m} = x^{-m}\left(1 + (m,1)x + (m,2)xx + (m,3)x^3 + \text{etc.}\right)$
Dadurch wird
$\Omega = z + (1,1)xz + (1,2)xxz + (1,3)x^3z + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{2}zz + \tfrac{1}{2}(2,1)xzz + \tfrac{1}{2}(2,2)xxzz + \tfrac{1}{2}(2,3)x^3zz + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{3}z^3 + \tfrac{1}{3}(3,1)xz^3 + \tfrac{1}{3}(3,2)xxz^3 + \tfrac{1}{3}(3,3)x^3z^3 + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{4}z^4 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,1)xz^4 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,2)xxz^4 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,3)x^3z^4 + \text{etc.}$
$+ \text{etc.}$
Nehmen wir an, dass die Substitution des Werths von z in diesem Ausdrucke gebe
$\Omega = u + \boxed{1,1}xu + \boxed{1,2}xxu + \boxed{1,3}x^3u + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{2}uu + \boxed{2,1}xuu + \boxed{2,2}xxuu + \boxed{2,3}x^3uu + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{3}u^3 + \boxed{3,1}xu^3 + \boxed{3,2}xxu^3 + \boxed{3,3}x^3u^3 + \text{etc.}$
$+ \tfrac{1}{4}u^4 + \boxed{4,1}xu^4 + \boxed{4,2}xxu^4 + \boxed{4,3}x^3u^4 + \text{etc.}$
$+ \text{etc.}$
So wird seyn
I. $u + \boxed{2,1}xuu + \boxed{3,2}xxu^3 + \boxed{4,3}x^3u^4 + \text{etc.} = z + \tfrac{1}{2}(2,1)xzz + \tfrac{1}{3}(3,2)xxz^3 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,3)x^3z^4 + \text{etc.}$
II. $\tfrac{1}{2}uu + \boxed{3,1}xu^3 + \boxed{4,2}xxu^4 + \boxed{5,3}x^3u^5 + \text{etc.} = \tfrac{1}{2}zz + \tfrac{1}{3}(3,1)xz^3 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,2)xxz^4 + \tfrac{1}{5}(5,3)x^3z^5 + \text{etc.}$
III. $\tfrac{1}{3}u^3 + \boxed{4,1}xu^4 + \boxed{5,2}xxu^5 + \boxed{6,3}x^3u^6 + \text{etc.} = \tfrac{1}{3}z^3 + \tfrac{1}{4}(4,1)xz^4 + \tfrac{1}{5}(5,2)xxz^5 + \tfrac{1}{6}(6,3)x^3z^6 + \text{etc.}$
IV. $\tfrac{1}{4}u^4 + \boxed{5,1}xu^5 + \boxed{6,2}xxu^6 + \boxed{7,3}x^3u^7 + \text{etc.} = \tfrac{1}{4}z^4 + \tfrac{1}{5}(5,1)xz^5 + \tfrac{1}{6}(6,2)xxz^6 + \tfrac{1}{7}(7,3)x^3z^7 + \text{etc.}$
u. s. w.

methods.what: Setup for series reversion: a power series y in x and an associated two-variable series z in u and x with the same coefficients
methods.quote:
$x + axx + bx^3 + cx^4 + \text{etc.} = y$
$u + axuu + bxxu^3 + cx^3u^4 + \text{etc.} = z$

methods.what: Auxiliary generating function defined by a logarithm
Notation (m,k) for the coefficients of the expansion of negative powers of y in powers of x
Expansion of Ω as a double series in x and z, obtained from −log(1−t) = Σ t^m/m together with the y^{-m} expansions
Re-expansion of Ω in powers of x and u after substituting z, with unknown boxed coefficients
Coefficient-matching identities that equate diagonal subseries of the two expansions (forms I–IV, continued in general)

items.english: Thus it will be [the identities I, II, III, IV, and so on]
